title: Mason D Probable NDE 9770
content: I overdosed on multiple types of drugs. I remember thinking I was just so high that I was tripping out. As I was walking down the hallways, it began to shrink down on me and become very narrow. I was bouncing off of the walls. I fell, crawled to the couch, and somehow laid down. Next thing I know, I am looking at my body from above the living room. Time was standing still, almost nonexistent. As my three friends were trying to wake me up, my eyes were open. They thought I was playing a joke on them. I could see and hear everything that was going on from above my body. My stepbrothers were playing on the television. My body was burning, like I was on fire. In my outer body, I was screaming and begging God to give me another chance, but nothing was coming out verbally. I could only hear and see what was happening, but not able to interact verbally. I remember coming back to my body. My heart was racing. I jumped up, stripped down naked, and got into the cold bath tub because I thought I was on fire. Later, I found out that I was unconscious for 45 minutes and had no pulse. I was traumatized for a few months. I was fighting through anxiety attacks, panic attacks and sleep paralysis most days. 13 years later, I have never touched a single drug since. I am a healthy 30-year-old with no health complications. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: 1/2011 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes. Drug or medication overdose. Life threatening event, but not clinical death How do you consider the content of your experience? Neither pleasant NOR distressing Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I was watching my friends try to wake me and then discuss that I was dead. I have also had Deja vu experiences from that experience. I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Less consciousness and alertness than normal. My consciousness was nonexistent but my alertness was very high. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? I was alert, just from outside of my body. Were your thoughts speeded up? Faster than usual Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning. It felt like it lasted a couple of minutes, but it was 45 minutes. Were your senses More vivid than usual? Incredibly more vivid Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. It was more tunnel vision, focusing more on what I was looking at. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. My hearing was very good. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Yes I believe the hallway that caved in on me was the tunnel Did you see any beings in your experience? I sensed their presence Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? No Did you see an unearthly light? Uncertain Darkness is what I remember Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? No What emotions did you feel during the experience? Scared and hopeless. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? No Did you have a feeling of joy? No Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? No Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? My past flashed before me, out of my control Did scenes from the future come to you? Scenes from my personal future. There have been times in life where I have felt Deja vu directed from that night. Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Christian- Other Christian I claimed to be a Christian but was not living the lifestyle of a Christian. Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Yes My Christian faith is much more of a lifestyle now. What is your religion now? Christian- Other Christian Today I am a devout Christian. Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I have never touched drugs since. Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? No Did you see deceased or religious spirits? I sensed their presence Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? No During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? No Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? Yes I felt like I was in hell's waiting room. Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Large changes in my life After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes Nobody believed me. To this day people make fun of the situation, thinking it was just a trip. How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes Most people think I was just tripping out and nothing major happened. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? Yes Certain events that spark Deja vu. Anxiety will bring back the feeling I experienced. Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? No Are there any other questions that we could ask to help you communicate your experience? No erwb3aq_nde
